verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer docs say you can pull data out through its API to sync to other systems and run analysis, and official SDKs exist to support that. This is a programmatic route to extracting data, but nothing describes a bulk export or the formats involved. Missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), confirmation that all data types (profiles, events, campaigns, flows, templates) are exportable, account closure or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
